opennyai_summary.decision:
Hence, the issue no.9 stand decided in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendant.
Relief.
The plaintiff is also entitled for a decree of permanent injunction against all the defendants Shashi Ojha Vs Awaneesh Chander Jha & Ors restraining them from creating third party interest in the suit property.
Further, the defendant is directed to perform his part of the contract and to execute a proper sale deed in respect of the property in question in favour of the plaintiff and put the plaintiff in vacant and peaceful possession of the suit property.
Alternate relief of recovery is not being granted.
The prayer of the plaintiff for Rs.90,000/- per month rent for 10 flats is allowed from the month of May 2017 till the date of recovery of possession.
The defendants are further directed to pay damages to the tune of Rs.2 lacs jointly for the mental agony and harassment faced by the plaintiff since 2015.
No special cost is allowed, as prayed by plaintiff.
